added_failures_note: derived by the reviewer from the reviewed run's own arm logs, since its unarmed manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite field: base arm logs/load/test_follower_checks_its_owner.run{1,2,3}.log (1 failed, 4 passed; 1 failed, 4 passed; 5 passed) against after arm logs/head/test_follower_checks_its_owner.run{1,2,3}.log (5 passed, EXIT=0 each) gives 0 ids failing at head that passed at base; the same instrument ordered the other way (head vs the loaded base arm) returns 1, tests/test_follower_checks_its_owner.py::test_a_read_only_follower_leaves_when_its_own_owner_dies, so the zero is a measurement rather than a vacuous absence. The store's own read path (reckon/crew/review.py:1201 annotate_review_of_run) re-derives from those two manifest fields alone, so a reader through read_review sees this pair as unmeasured while the file on disk carries the figure above.

findings.text: the tests field records the gate as "-n 8 -q <file>" with an unsubstituted <file> placeholder and an unexpanded $PWD, which the node's own manifest contract forbids, so the field names no command that ran and the gate cannot be re-run from the record.

the declared negative control reddens on two ids and only the first is the mutation's: test_a_read_only_follower_leaves_when_its_own_owner_dies fails in the reverted-bound window, while test_a_reload_under_a_live_subreaper_keeps_the_dead_owner fails with "the follower left without replacing its image" under the unchanged RELOAD_WITHIN_SECONDS, so the log does not isolate the reverted constant and a reader must read past the first summary to see which red the mutation caused.

evidence_inputs names the relaxed constant as asserted "at :481 and :485" while the same constant is read at eleven lines of the file it bounds (tests/test_follower_checks_its_owner.py:297, 312, 369, 376, 388, 406, 688, 880 and :904 besides those two), so the reach of a relaxation that also widens two other ids' assertions and five subprocess timeouts is understated for a reader judging which bounds moved.

the comment replacing the previous rationale drops the pass-count sensitivity the deleted one carried, so the file no longer records what the relaxed bound tolerates: at the 0.1 s wait pass the new eight-second bound admits about eighty passes before it stops separating a follower that checks its owner from one that checks it rarely, where the two-second bound it replaced allowed about twenty and said so.
